```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(car)
library(performance)
library(caret)
library(glmnet)
library(doParallel)
library(parallel)
library(broom)
source("util.R")
```

```{r}
book26 = read.csv("data/book26.csv")
book26 = set_types(book26)

book26 = book26 %>% 
  mutate(
    AvgSeverity = ClaimAmount / ClaimNb
  )

train = book26 %>%
  filter(Year <= 2025)

test = book26 %>%
  filter(Year == 2026)
```

```{r}
all_predictors = c(
  "DriverAge", "YearsLicensed", "VehAge",
  "VehValue", "VehicleType", "RiskZone",
  "Density", "AnnualKms", "ExcessChosen",
  "GaragingLocation", "VehicleUse",
  "NCDLevel", "TenureYears",
  "MultiPolicyFlag", "PaymentFrequency"
)

f <- as.formula(
  paste("ClaimAmount ~", paste(all_predictors, collapse = " + "))
)

m = lm(f, data = train)
vif_data <- check_collinearity(m)
plot(vif_data)
vif_data

# remove driver age and density
predictors = setdiff(
  all_predictors, c("DriverAge", "Density")
)

pred_formula <- as.formula(
  paste("~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "))
)
```

```{r}
# Performing lasso regression on the frequency
x_train_matrix = model.matrix(pred_formula, train)
y_train_matrix = as.matrix(train$ClaimNb)


cl <- makeCluster(detectCores() - 1)
registerDoParallel(cl)

cv_lasso <- cv.glmnet(
  x_train_matrix,
  y_train_matrix,
  family = "poisson",
  type.measure = "deviance",
  alpha = 1,
  nfolds = 10,
  parallel = TRUE
)
stopCluster(cl)

plot(cv_lasso$glmnet.fit, xvar = "lambda", main = "Lasso for frequency")

freq_lasso = glmnet(x_train_matrix, y_train_matrix, alpha = 1, lambda = cv_lasso$lambda.min)
coef(freq_lasso)
# For the frequency model TenureYears is further dropped by lasso regularisation
```

```{r}
# Severity needs to filter the training dataset to policies that claimed
train = filter(train, ClaimNb > 0)

x_train_matrix = model.matrix(pred_formula, train)
y_train_matrix = as.matrix(train$AvgSeverity)

cl <- makeCluster(detectCores() - 1)
registerDoParallel(cl)

cv_lasso <- cv.glmnet(
  x_train_matrix,
  y_train_matrix,
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  type.measure = "deviance",
  alpha = 1,
  nfolds = 10,
  parallel = TRUE
)
stopCluster(cl)

plot(cv_lasso$glmnet.fit, xvar = "lambda", main = "Lasso for severity")

sev_lasso = glmnet(x_train_matrix, y_train_matrix, alpha = 1, lambda = cv_lasso$lambda.min)
coef(sev_lasso)

# Severity drops no predictors in the lasso
```
